svg.title: Defense in depth: overlapping layers of control
svg.desc: Concentric layers around a central asset, numbered from the outside in: one, policies and people with training; two, physical controls such as locks and guards; three, the perimeter with firewalls and IDS or IPS; four, the internal network with segmentation; five, the host with EDR and patching; six, the application with hardening and SAST; seven, data with encryption and DLP. An attacker must get through every layer to reach the asset.
svg.text: Defense in depth: overlapping layers of control
